findings.evidence: Lines 51 and 120 set only `NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C` and `Coalgebra R C`; lines 122-125 call the result the diagonal coaction over a bialgebra, while Mathlib defines `Bialgebra` as extending both `Algebra R A` and `Coalgebra R A` with compatibility laws in `Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Basic.lean:57`.
findings.fix: Require the actual bialgebra structure for the coaction-facing declarations, e.g. `[Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]` (or rename/segregate these as raw maps and avoid calling them coactions until the bialgebra section).
findings.issue: `tensorCoact` and `tensorCoact_natural` are exported as the tensor-product coaction under only `[Coalgebra R C]` plus `[NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C]`, so multiplication need not be compatible with the coalgebra; outside a bialgebra this map is just a raw formula, not the mathematically justified tensor-comodule coaction.

summary: The diagonal tensor coaction is stated under hypotheses too weak for the advertised bialgebra construction: it is available for an arbitrary coalgebra with an unrelated bilinear multiplication, so the declaration name/docs overstate its mathematical status.
